item.title: '$200 bn market in 15 countries': Here's what India can do if US slaps 100% tariffs
item.summary: As the US contemplates imposing substantial tariffs on Russian crude, India is strategically exploring alternative markets to bolster its exports. With fifteen potential markets worth an impressive two hundred billion dollars, Indian exporters are adapting to global challenges. In contrast to the US, where merchandise exports reached eighty-seven billion dollars, shipments to alternative destinations are growing more rapidly, indicating resilient export dynamics.
